correctness.rationale: The proof is reconstructed from exact definitions. The centered degree-eight polynomial is derived directly. The quotient quartic has Galois group S4 from certified unramified factorization types 4 and 3+1. The rational product of square roots forces even sign parity; the unramified 4+2+1+1 factorization modulo 7 supplies a weight-two kernel element, whose S4 conjugates generate the full even sign kernel. Exact enumeration then gives 75 fixed-point elements out of 192. The finite verifier replays every polynomial/factor/count certificate; the only non-finite ingredient is the standard Frobenius--Chebotarev correspondence explicitly separated in the proof.
